title: SCIM provisioning
subtitle: Issue a SCIM 2.0 bearer token so your identity provider (Azure AD, Okta, OneLogin) can sync users into this workspace automatically.

errors.revoke: Couldn't revoke the token. It is still active.

reveal.title: Copy your new SCIM token now
reveal.body: You won't see this token again. Paste it into your identity provider now; we store only a hash.

reveal.role: New users get the {{role}} role by default.

generate.heading: Generate a new SCIM token
generate.intro: New users provisioned via this token get the role you choose here by default.

setup.heading: IdP setup instructions
setup.intro: SCIM 2.0 base URL and configuration for Azure AD, Okta, and OneLogin.
setup.authBody: Bearer token (paste the value shown when generating).
setup.azureBody: Enterprise applications → your app → Provisioning. Set "Tenant URL" to the base URL above and paste the token into "Secret Token". Test connection then start provisioning.
setup.oktaBody: Application → Provisioning → Integration. Enable API integration, paste the base URL into "SCIM connector base URL" and the token under "OAuth Bearer Token".

table.heading: Tokens
table.emptyBody: Generate a bearer token and paste it into your identity provider (Azure AD, Okta, Google Workspace) to start provisioning users automatically.
